_readme: Reasonix owns this tool and capability vocabulary, and the field names of the tool record in its own transcript. LeapMux owns the envelope key it wraps that record in. The worker and frontend use the same identifiers.

Ask.why: the browser spells `Yolo` alone, for the bypass preset it builds; Reasonix itself labels the three choices on the option group the worker forwards, so no browser code words this one
